prompt: Which tasks use the same seen-before membership pattern? Select all that apply.

options.text: Reject a username if it already appeared earlier in a signup stream.
Detect whether the current page URL was visited earlier in this session.
Flag a transaction ID when the same ID has already been processed.
Count exactly how many times every word occurs in a document.
Find the third-smallest value in an unsorted array.

explanation: The username, page, and transaction tasks only need to know whether the current item is already in a set of earlier items. Exact frequency counting needs counts, while finding the third-smallest value is an ordering problem.
